title: Working from Home
topic: ข่าว/สังคม (ข้อมูล)
lines: Before 2020, only about five percent of workers in the United States
worked mainly from home. During the pandemic, **this** figure jumped to
nearly sixty percent. Today, it has settled at around thirty percent,
which is still six times higher than before.
Surveys show that most remote workers want to keep **it** that way. They
say they save time and money on travel and can spend more time with their
families. **Many** also report being more productive at home, although
managers do not always agree. In one survey, 85 percent of managers said
they found it hard to trust that remote staff were working.
Remote work has also changed cities. Office buildings in some downtown
areas are half empty, and the cafés and shops that depended on office
workers have lost customers. On the other hand, small towns have gained
new residents who no longer need to live near **their** workplace.
Experts believe the future will be "hybrid": two or three days in the
office and the rest at home. **This**, they say, gives companies the
face-to-face contact they need while keeping workers happy.

options: the number of workers in the U.S.
the percentage of workers who worked mainly from home
